decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with strong fit to the firm's established range and continued collection relevance, it is likely to stay.
It supports the decorative assortment well, but its lower prominence and more style-driven character leave some risk of later rationalization.
Its flame-retardant functionality and clear value for contract and hospitality interiors make it strategically important to retain.

Its niche decorative role, lower website prominence and wool-blend construction make it the most likely candidate for portfolio cleanup as the firm shifts resources toward stronger and more sustainable lines.
